Little white spired cottages cling to the canyon walls in stacked tiers, their balconies cantilevered over the drop, glowing windows dotting the green-furred cliffs from rim to river.
Charming white turreted dwellings perch on the wet ledges beside the waterfall, half-wreathed in its spray and rainbows, warm windows glowing through the mist.
Cozy white cottages are nestled into and built among the colossal mossy boulders, doorways set into the rock, little spires rising from the gaps between the stones.
Slender white elven houses cantilever out over the rushing stream on timber brackets, their peaked roofs reflected in the water below, amber windows hovering above the current.
Snug white cottages are tucked into hollows carved into the cliff-face, their arched facades flush with the rock, window-glow seeping gold from within the stone.
White dwellings wind their way around and between the colossal tree-trunks, rooms built into the bark, little spired rooftops visible through the canopy, every window softly lit.
Tiny white towers rise from the rocky islets midstream, connected by rope-and-plank bridges, their spires reflected in the eddying water, warm light shining from each narrow window.
White elven cottages spill down the ravine sides in tumbling cascades, each dwelling a step below the last, their glowing windows forming winding chains of light down the slope.
Cheerful white cottages straddle the creek on slender stilts, the water chattering beneath their floors, small spires pointing skyward, lantern-warm windows mirrored in the stream below.
White dwellings are carved directly into the rock pinnacle, tier upon tier spiraling upward, their windows glowing like embedded embers in the ancient stone face.
Rows of white spired cottages are built along the mossy top of a great fallen log, their foundations sunk into the bark, glowing windows lining its length like a tiny lantern-lit street.
Petite white homes nestle into the roots of enormous ancient trees, root-arches forming their doorways, spires poking up between the gnarled wood, every window warm and amber-lit.
White cottages hug the underside of a broad stone overhang, hanging like barnacles from the rock ceiling, their inverted gardens trailing downward and windows glowing upward into the stone.
A cluster of white turreted cottages is built onto and around a great arched stone bridge, rooms stacked atop its span and clinging to its piers, windows glowing over the gorge.
White elven dwellings wrap the curving edge of a tiered stone terrace above a misty pool, each cottage stepping down toward the water, glowing windows reflected in the still surface.
Cozy white cottages nestle into the steep ferny banks of a sunken lane, half-buried in greenery, their spires barely clearing the ground above, warm windows peering from the earth.
White spired houses are built into the layered shelves of a sedimentary cliff, each stratum forming a ready-made floor, glowing windows aligned in neat horizontal rows across the rockface.
Tiny white dwellings cling to the gnarled outer branches of the great canopy trees, platforms lashed to the boughs, spires swaying gently, warm windows glowing high above the forest floor.

White cottages are nestled among the sculptural columns of a basalt formation, their walls fitted neatly between the hexagonal stone pillars, little spires rising above the geometric rockscape, windows aglow.
Charming white homes are built right into the mossy earthen bank of a hillside spring, their back walls earth, water trickling past their doorsteps, windows glowing warm in the green shade.

White elven cottages cluster on the broad flat caps of ancient mushroom-shaped rock pedestals, reached by zigzag stairs cut into the stone, their spires silhouetted against the sky, windows alight below.
Neat white dwellings are tucked under the arching canopy of a dense hedgerow embankment, their facades set into the living green wall, spires poking through the foliage, windows gleaming within.
White cottages march along a narrow ridge-spine in single file, one after another with barely a gap between, balconies on both sides over twin drops, glowing windows lining the spine like beads.
Clusters of white spired cottages are built into and around the calcified terraces of a mineral spring, their foundations set into the pale stone tiers, warm windows glowing above the steaming pools.

White turreted dwellings are woven among the thick tangled roots of a banyan-like great tree, rooms fitted into root-formed chambers, spires threading upward through the living lattice, every window softly glowing.
